name: Credential Harvesting On-Site
description: Physical environments are rich with credential exposure — passwords on sticky notes, whiteboards with system credentials, unlocked workstations with cached sessions, printed access lists, and network equipment with default credentials visible on labels. Systematic documentation of these exposures during physical access is a high-value deliverable that demonstrates the downstream risk of physical access beyond just the entry itself.

blue.det: Camera footage of individual photographing screens or whiteboards; clean desk policy violation discovered; employee reports suspicious photography.
blue.cm: Clean desk policy strictly enforced; screen privacy filters on monitors in open areas; whiteboard policy — sensitive info erased after use; camera detection in sensitive areas; visitor escort.
